report_express.title: Electronic Document (Web Reporting) Solution
report_express.subtitle: ReportExpress Enterprise
report_express.oneLiner: Non-ActiveX based All-in-One integrated digital document system handling creation, inquiry, conversion, and storage at once
report_express.overview: ReportExpress Enterprise is the optimal web reporting solution for integrated management of all digital document tasks within a company in a web environment. Based on **HTML5 web standard technology**, it supports the entire process from document creation to electronic signature and safe storage, strictly complying with international **PDF standards**. It ensures optimal customization and flexible scalability for various business environments such as public/educational institutions and Tier 1 financial institutions.

features.text: Intuitive form development environment using a dedicated form tool
PKI electronic signature and timestamp authentication for document authenticity
Supports PDF digital document generation and long-term storage systems
Image conversion and high-performance dedicated viewer
Non-ActiveX / No Plugin based web standard architecture

report_express.strengths: A true web standard solution that works in all environments without separate installation, providing exceptional **technology** and **scalability**. It maximizes document **reliability** by embedding electronic signatures for non-repudiation and certificate verification. It automates document distribution and management **efficiency** through perfect integration with other systems like EDMS.
report_express.catchyPhrase: 💡 Elevate business efficiency and reliability with a web standard-based integrated digital document system.

rx_cert.title: Forgery Prevention Solution
rx_cert.subtitle: RX-Cert
rx_cert.oneLiner: Powerful anti-forgery electronic certificate solution ensuring document authenticity through encrypted barcodes and QR codes
rx_cert.overview: RX-Cert is a cutting-edge **secure document solution** that can perfectly verify the authenticity of important documents such as various certificates, licenses, and contracts. By applying 2D high-density barcode, QR code, and **PKI electronic signature technology**, it fundamentally blocks forgery attempts. It ensures business **reliability** and **efficiency** by providing the entire process from document issuance to inquiry and verification as a real-time online service.

features.text: Strong encryption of document information through 2D high-density barcode technology
Instant and easy original verification service using QR codes
Enhanced document security with PKI electronic signatures and watermarks
Provides output control and security-only EXE modules
Rapid authenticity verification anytime, anywhere via mobile app
Maximizes user accessibility as an HTML5-based no-install service

rx_cert.strengths: Ensures document **reliability** and universal **scalability** as timestamp and signature verification are possible even in general PDF viewers. It possesses the **technology** to perfectly block document forgery based on the **DES encryption algorithm**. It boasts **scalability** that can be flexibly applied to various issuance environments by supporting digital kiosks and web API integration.
rx_cert.catchyPhrase: 💡 Innovate the security level of core documents with a certificate anti-forgery solution applied with high-level encryption technology.

rx_loan.title: Loan Agreement Solution
rx_loan.subtitle: RX Loan
rx_loan.oneLiner: Efficient digital agreement platform perfectly supporting Hangul (HWP) UI and integrated processing of loan agreement tasks
rx_loan.overview: RX Loan is an **integrated digital agreement system** that innovatively improves the loan agreement process, a core business in the financial sector. It perfectly implements the familiar **Hangul (HWP) document environment** in a web environment. It is a platform that maximizes work **efficiency** with an intuitive interface that can process everything from agreement drafting to output and report generation on one screen. It is optimized for various agreement and document tasks in Tier 1 financial institutions, insurance companies, and public/educational institutions.

features.text: Provides a seamless working environment with Web Hangul (HWP) UI support
Supports automatic page breaking and complex document merging
Integrated DB-linked output and electronic signature functions for non-repudiation
Automatic generation and download of reports in PDF and Excel formats
Can implement dynamic documents with various charts and script support

rx_loan.strengths: Innovates business **efficiency** by enabling rapid document drafting and review with a user-friendly interface. It possesses the **technology** to minimize human error by automatically generating agreement documents based on input data and enabling report output. It increased system **scalability** and user convenience by integrating document editing, approval, and management functions in a Hangul-compatible environment.
rx_loan.catchyPhrase:
Application Cases
* Tier 1 Financial: Next-generation loan agreement automation system
* Insurance: Integrated digital contract management platform
* Public/Educational: Integration of approval documents and report output systems

pr1.question: What is the procedure for product introduction?
pr1.answer: Please contact us through the inquiry form on the website or call our main number, and a professional consultant will guide you through the introduction procedure in detail.

pr2.question: I would like to apply for a product demo.
pr2.answer: Demo applications are possible through online inquiry or phone. After confirmation, our staff will visit or demonstrate the demo remotely.

pr3.question: Inquiry about license policy.
pr3.answer: License policies vary by product, so please contact the sales team for more details.

s1.question: How can I receive technical support?
s1.answer: We operate a technical support portal and hotline for customers who have signed a maintenance contract. Details will be provided at the time of contract.

s2.question: What are the technical support operating hours?
answer: We operate from 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays, excluding lunch time (12 PM to 1 PM) and weekends/holidays.
In case of emergency failures, please contact the technical support hotline (0505-998-0888), and our staff will guide you.

s3.question: How do I receive remote support?
answer: First, call our main number (02-6949-4170), and our staff will check your inquiry.
If remote support is needed, access 988.co.kr according to the staff's instructions and enter the 6-digit authentication code.

s4.question: How do I proceed with a maintenance contract?
answer: A maintenance contract can be signed separately through the sales representative after product introduction.
The scope of technical support and response time may vary depending on the contract details, so please contact our staff for details.

i1.question: An error occurs during installation.
i1.answer: Please refer to the installation guide or contact the technical support team, and we will resolve it quickly.

i2.question: When the installation guide appears repeatedly even after installing the program
answer: Please delete the existing program and reinstall it.
If it persists after reinstallation, you need to check if it's blocked by the PC's security program (antivirus, etc.).

i3.question: When the program does not run due to an 'Application Not Responding' error
i3.answer: If it still doesn't run after reinstalling the program, please temporarily turn off the real-time monitoring function of the security program or check the block list.

p1.question: When the 'Processing' status persists on the preview screen
answer: Please close the preview window and run it again.
If the problem persists, please remove the program and reinstall it.

p2.question: When the printer does not respond after clicking the print button
answer: Please turn the printer off and on to check the connection status.
If not resolved, register the same driver as a new one through 'Add Printer' in the Control Panel and try printing to that printer.

p3.question: When the document is stuck in the print queue and not printing
answer: Go to [PC Settings → Devices → Printers & Scanners].
Click 'Open Queue' for the printer you are using, delete all pending documents, and try printing again.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.summary: CM Innovation Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the 'Company') establishes and discloses the following privacy policy in accordance with Article 30 of the 「Personal Information Protection Act」 to protect customers' personal information and guarantee the rights and interests of information subjects.
privacy_policy.section1_content:
The Company processes personal information for the following purposes. Processed personal information will not be used for purposes other than the following.
* Responding to customer inquiries and technical support services
* Requesting contracts and quotes, maintenance management
* Processing digital document, authentication, report solution related tasks
* Providing website services and member management
privacy_policy.section2_content:
The Company may process the following personal information items for service use.
* Required items: Name, Company, Position, Email, Contact
* Optional items: Service use records, access logs, cookies, IP address, etc.
privacy_policy.section3_content:
The Company immediately destroys personal information after the purpose of collection and use is achieved. However, if retention is necessary in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, it is retained as follows.
* Records related to contracts and transactions: 5 years (Electronic Commerce Act, etc.)
* Records related to service use: 3 years (Communications Privacy Protection Act, etc.)
privacy_policy.section4_content: In principle, the Company does not provide users' personal information to external parties. However, it is provided only when the information subject's prior consent is obtained or there are special provisions in the law.
privacy_policy.section9_content:
Privacy Officer: Executive Director Ji-hoon Yoo
Phone: 02-6949-4170
Email: support@cminnovation.co.kr

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CM Innovation (hereinafter referred to as the 'Company') establishes and discloses personal information processing guidelines as follows in order to protect the personal information of information subjects (customers) and process related grievances promptly and smoothly in accordance with Article 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act.
privacy.section1_content:
The Company processes personal information for the following purposes and does not use it for purposes other than the following.
- Confirmation of customer's intention to join, identification/authentication according to service provision to customers, maintenance/management of membership, payment for goods or services, supply/delivery of goods or services, etc.
privacy.section2_content1: ① The Company processes and retains personal information within the period of personal information retention/use agreed upon when collecting personal information from the information subject or within the period of personal information retention/use according to statutes.
privacy.section2_content2: ② The specific personal information processing and retention periods are as follows.
privacy.section2_item1: Customer registration and management: Until the service use contract or membership is terminated; however, if a bond/debt relationship remains, until the relevant bond/debt relationship is settled.
privacy.section2_item2: Records on contracts or withdrawal of subscription, payment, and supply of goods in electronic commerce: 5 years
privacy.section3_content: The Company does not provide personal information to third parties except in cases that fall under Article 17 of the Personal Information Protection Act, such as the separate consent of the information subject or special provisions of the law.
privacy.section4_content1: ① The Company entrusts the processing of personal information as follows for smooth personal information business processing.
privacy.section4_content2: ② When signing a consignment contract, the Company specifies in documents matters concerning prohibition of processing personal information for purposes other than the performance of entrusted business, technical/managerial protection measures, restrictions on re-consignment, management/supervision of the trustee, and liability, and supervises whether the trustee processes personal information safely.
privacy.section5_content: The information subject may exercise the following rights related to personal information protection at any time against the Company.
privacy.section5_item1: 1. Request for access to personal information
privacy.section5_item2: 2. Request for correction in case of errors, etc.
privacy.section6_content: The Company processes the following personal information items.
privacy.section6_item1: Name, Date of Birth, Address, Phone Number, Mobile Number, Gender, Email Address
privacy.section7_content1: ① The Company destroys personal information without delay when it becomes unnecessary, such as the expiration of the retention period or achievement of the purpose of processing.
privacy.section7_content2: ② The Company destroys personal information in the following ways.
privacy.section7_item1: Electronic files: Deleting the file and formatting storage media such as disks
privacy.section8_content: The Company takes the following measures to ensure the safety of personal information.
privacy.section8_item1: Administrative measures: Establishment/implementation of internal management plans, regular training for employees, etc.
privacy.section8_item2: Technical measures: Management of access rights such as setting passwords for personal information processing systems (or computers storing personal information), installation of security programs such as vaccines, encryption of files storing personal information
privacy.section8_item3: Physical measures: Locking of places where personal information is stored/kept, access control, etc.
privacy.section9_content: The Company has designated a privacy officer as follows to take overall responsibility for personal information processing and handle complaints and damage relief.
privacy.footer: This Privacy Policy is effective from September 30, 2011.
